added_models.model: PBPK model from a human IV/oral microdose study (PF-05089771)

dose.confidence_note: Opening year is a proxy: the microdose study NCT01165736 started 2010-07; the PBPK prediction was made before the SAD study (NCT01259882, 2010-12). Abstract-level.
dose.judgement: Opening entry at the model's first use; the prediction was not public until 2016.
dose.quote: A physiologically-based PK (PBPK) model was used to predict exposure and multiples of Nav1.7 50 % inhibitory concentration (IC50) for each compound at higher doses.
dose.note: PBPK model built on microdose PK predicted the oral dose giving about 12x Nav1.7 IC50 at Cmax for PF-05089771.

dose.magnitude_basis: PBPK-predicted vs observed plasma exposure of PF-05089771 in the single ascending oral dose study
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level (Springer full text not retrieved), so the fold error behind 'compared well' is unknown and magnitude is null. SAD registry NCT01259882 has no posted results found. IEM-patient exposure versus the IC50 multiple not checked (Cao 2016 paywalled).
dose.judgement: Healthy-volunteer PK counts for dose. The PBPK model stated an exposure target (12x IC50 at Cmax with 1 g); the SAD study, run after the prediction, matched it, and IEM patients then got 1600 mg, above the predicted 1 g. Reaching target is scored here; whether it worked is efficacy.
dose.quote: In a subsequent single ascending oral dose clinical study, the predictions for PF-05089771 compared well with observed data.
dose.note: Single ascending oral doses in volunteers matched the PBPK exposure predictions; the IEM trial then dosed 1600 mg.

considered_not_added: Healthy-volunteer evoked pain battery (Siebenga 2020, NCT02349607, PF-05089771 150 mg BID): no analgesia, but run in 2015 after the IEM result at about a tenth of the IEM dose, and the paper attributes the gap to dose ('these patients were administered a single dose of 1,600 mg'); not a comparison of a model prediction with IEM patients

Patient iPSC sensory neurons from other IEM lines (McDermott 2023 Brain; Thornton 2025 Clin Transl Med): same system as the draft's iem-patient-ipsc-sensory-neurons track; McDermott uses no member drug and Thornton screens AZ compounds only
Mouse/human DRG ex vivo (Alexandrou 2016 PLoS One; Fujita 2026 eLife, AM-2099): pharmacology of PF-05089771 or a non-member, no comparison with IEM patients

Rodent pain models (Yang 2025 Pain review of 43 preclinical studies; intrathecal PF-05089771 mouse 2026): no rodent efficacy study of a member compared with IEM results; the review is not a source and notes rat Nav1.7 is less sensitive to PF-05089771
Funapide (XEN402/XPF-001/XPF-002) preclinical models: none published; no Xenon animal, ex-vivo or PK model found to compare with Goldberg 2012 or NCT01486446

Genotype-guided structural modelling plus functional profiling of patient mutant channels (Yang 2012 Nat Commun; Geha 2016 JAMA Neurol): validated only on carbamazepine, a non-member, so it does not score for this class
Heterologous expression of patients' mutant Nav1.7 channels tested with a member: not found in the abstracts read (Cao 2016 body paywalled)
